protocol.generation: greedy, EOS respected, max16 MCQ/max48 open; same tokenizer/chat template and original HF BF16 per model
protocol.quality_target: <=1pp loss vs full in correctness and format; mean reference NLL delta<=.05 nats/token
protocol.speed_target: Natural wall AND same16-token workload upper95 paired ratio<=.90, with actual skipped blocks and lower analytic FLOPs
protocol.uncertainty: 32 prompts insufficient to establish1pp population noninferiority; positive pilot means promising, not confirmed success
protocol.cache: One prompt-only mask after first2 prefill layers; fixed for all decode, skipped caches offset0, active caches aligned
protocol.random: Fixed random4 and separately adaptive-count-matched random; matched controls pay identical adaptive probe computation
protocol.novelty: Two project-local hypotheses, global novelty unconfirmed. BI static is ShortGPT-inspired partial baseline; no LayerSkip training reproduction
protocol.costs: Real CPU/synchronized wall/MLX peak memory. GPU elapsed, power and money unmeasured. Dense matmul FLOPs analytic, not hardware counter.
protocol.fixed_work: 8 prespecified pilot inputs, baseline-derived token sequence padded with EOS to16; gate cannot see future tokens; not free-running quality
protocol.quality_evaluation: Reference NLL once/method/question with generated prompt-only mask frozen; evaluation time separately logged, no policy using reference tokens
